column8: ["Both circular seats are filled by domed teal caps instead of left empty; paint open sockets centred on the scaffold dots with broad, unobstructed interiors.","The central brass connector shows a raised rear ridge and a dark front side face, making it read as an oblique view rather than a straight-down plan.","The teal caps carry upper-left highlights and lower-right shading; replace this directional lighting with even albedo and symmetric tonal structure.","Small upright brass tabs along the connector clutter the functional channel with ornamental hardware; simplify it into one broad, continuous link."]
